scope: A/B preregistered humidity-axis re-inversion (task-humidity-axis): how much of the R=7.110 cross-event spread of the task-5 low-layer increment pool can the pinned OPAC humidity growth absorb? Variant A (RH-only) root-finds the free-troposphere humidity per event on the pinned domain [0.5, 0.99]; variant B ladders the task-5 inversion machine verbatim over the pinned RH knots {50, 70, 99}% for the residual antarctic-form increment. Calibration lane: every value is relative to the humidified production baseline and is calibrated, not a physical prior; nothing here enters the default model. The preregistered block (verbatim module constant, pytest-pinned; the R_RH band generated from humidity_axis_priors.json) is written before results; B(50%) reproduces the committed task-5 pool bitwise before any other result; the R_RH verdicts are the mechanical application of the preregistered bands with the preregistered participation rule.

preregistered.baseline: every value is relative to the PRODUCTION two-layer default (fixed_opac_strat) whose free-troposphere layer carries the pinned humidity growth (eclipse/aerosol.py ft_growth_factor; f(0.5) exactly 1.0, q_rest gate enforced at import); the increment (variant B) is the task-5 antarctic-form extra column; a zero increment restores the humidified baseline bitwise and at rh=0.5 the humidified table is bitwise the production table

ladder.knot_source: pinned WASO ext550 knots (humidity_axis_priors.json waso_growth_knots; sha256 per knot)
ladder.semantics: variant B evaluates the task-5 inversion machine verbatim at each knot (table override; same objective, splits, morphology, bracket, root finder); the ladder carries the joint (rh, a_res) family through per-knot scalar roots - the task-5 closure target reduces per event to a single scalar (brentq on one AOD), so a 2-parameter joint root is not recoverable and this realization is preregistered
ladder.interpolation: between knots the FT growth is the pinned linear-in-RH interpolation (eclipse/aerosol.py); the ladder itself never interpolates

variant_a.objective: g(rh) = fit-subset median ln(P(rh)/O) with P through the humidified table; monotone nonincreasing in rh (more humidity -> more extinction -> every prediction decreases)
variant_a.branch_unclosed: g(0.99) > 0 -> the pinned growth range cannot close the event; status unclosed, not forced; its accounts evaluate the before-state at the reference and the after-state at the domain top (the closest achievable humidity-only state)
variant_a.branch_closed_at_reference: g(0.5) <= 0 -> the reference state already closes the event; status closed_at_reference (not expected: all four task-5 pools are positive)
variant_a.branch_dark: a dark g evaluation inside the domain fails loud (the pinned growth range is far from the underflow cliff)

variant_b.free_parameters: (rh, a_res) jointly, realized as the ladder: rh takes the pinned knot values, a_res is the per-knot scalar root of the task-5 objective
variant_b.branch_over_closed: g(0) < 0 at a knot: the humidified baseline is already darker than the fit subset, so the closure equation has no nonnegative root; the residual is 0 (nothing applied) and the status is over_closed - the humidity axis alone overshoots this event at this knot
variant_b.branch_zero_increment: g(0) == 0 at a knot: status zero_increment (task-5 convention)

preregistered.b50_reproduction_gate: B(50%) must reproduce the committed task-5 pool (validation/results/atmosphere_inversion/inversion.json retrieval_spec.aod550_pool) BITWISE for every event, before any other result is produced; f(0.5)==1.0 exactly makes the humidified table bitwise the production table, so the gate proves the machine reproduction, not an assumption

r_rh_band.structural_domain: [1, infinity): R_RH is a max/min ratio of positive residuals; values below 1 are structurally unreachable and not preregistered
r_rh_band.band_edge_source: descriptive transcription of the mechanical edges imported from validation/extinction_gap_diagnosis.py (VERDICT_COMPATIBLE[1], VERDICT_TENSION[1]); the consumer asserts edge-value equality at import and applies the verdict through the imported constants only
r_rh_band.participation_rule: per ladder point: events with a positive inverted residual participate; zero-increment, over-closed and unclosed events are listed separately with their status; fewer than 2 participating events -> mechanical status degenerate, no band verdict
r_rh_band.evidence_grade_note: a ratio over n participating events is reported with n_participating; a 2-event ratio is not a 4-event R and carries weaker evidence
r_rh_band.interpretation_note: preregistered budget expectation, FALSIFIED by the machine results of the A/B re-inversion: the plan-phase linear AOD budget predicted R_RH(70%) > R=7.110, arguing that the same absolute FT growth increment is removed from every event's baseline so the residual ratio first widens and then narrows. The measured value (A/B product r_rh['0.7']) is 7.023 < 7.110 because the per-event absorption effectiveness of the FT humidification against the antarctic-form increment is not 1:1 (measured ratios are recorded in the A/B product's humidity_sufficiency.effectiveness account); the equal-absolute-removal premise does not hold. Neither the expectation nor its falsification is a red flag by itself; the band verdicts are applied mechanically to the measured residuals.

share_table.definition: share(rh, event) = 1 - a_res(rh, event)/a_pool(event) for inverted knots; a_res == 0 -> share capped at 1.0; over_closed and unclosed knots carry no share (listed with their status)
share_table.reading: share is a measured absorption share under the preregistered semantics, not a causal claim that humidity explains the event; the residual event-specificity stays a separate account

preregistered.holdout_accounts: per variant per ladder point per event: fit (g0 -> g at the root), holdout (before/after median and RMS), shape ledger (committed aggregation structure); the before-state is the production reference baseline (rh=0.5, bitwise the task-5 baseline) and the after-state is the variant's terminal state - variant A: rh* (or the domain top when unclosed), variant B: the knot's root state (over-closed knots evaluate at the zero increment, the applied model state)
preregistered.anchoring: production-baseline anchoring gates (atmosphere_inversion.run_anchoring_gates) plus per-table humidified path identity (production grid bitwise, stratosphere tau bitwise, FT tau linear within 1e-12, full bitwise equality at rh=0.5), enforced inside the table factory so every evaluation walks a verified path

reproduction.rule: abs_diff <= max(1e-06 * |committed|, 1e-09) per readout (tolerances imported from extinction_gap_diagnosis)

chain_identity.exact_leg_1990: observed = prediction/model_to_observed recovers the record's own observed_minimum_to_reference bitwise

production_baseline.moment_gate: zeroth-moment gate over the committed variants passed (build_height_stats, single source)

preregistered_proxy.grade: linear_aod_budget_proxy: assumes the antarctic-form increment and the FT humidification are interchangeable 1:1 in AOD550; this product's own machine results falsified that premise (see effectiveness and proxy_vs_model), so these values are retained for audit only and are NOT the sufficiency verdict

model_verdict.basis: variant A machine results: the humidified baseline alone closes the fit subset within the pinned domain (rh*), or the domain-top residual stays positive (unclosed)

effectiveness.definition: absorbed increment AOD550 (a_pool - residual at the 0.7 knot) per unit extra FT AOD550 (0.013*(f(0.7)-1)); measured on this product's own machine results

log_rh_interpolation_bracket.semantics: the pinned ext550 knots interpolated linearly in log(RH) (validation-side alternative; the production axis stays linear-in-RH); exact knot queries return the pinned knot value, so closure statuses at the domain endpoints are identical under both semantics

j3_dormant_ruling.ruling: calibration-lane increment layers stay pinned at the 50% reference state (f=1): the (B-A) share measurement requires the humidity axis to be an attribute of the prior only, not of the calibrated increment - the same RH must not act twice through a calibrated artifact (J3)
j3_dormant_ruling.antarctic_switch_rule: dormant (not triggered): the antarctic-type composition files (SUSO 6/8, SSAM 8/8, MITR 00 recovered) have pinned knots making synthesis feasible, and no increment layer consumes humidity under this ruling. Fallback chain preregistered for any follow-up task that humidifies increment layers: synthesize the antarctic composition first (Table 4 row, mass values at RH 50%: sulfate SUSO n_j=0.998, sea salt accumulation SSAM n_j=0.109e-2, mineral transported MITR n_j=0.123e-3; the SUSO 50% knot is missing and would need interpolation), switch to a WASO-class morphology only if synthesis proves infeasible

j4_stratosphere_ruling.ruling: no humidity parameter: Table 3 declares RH states only for boundary aerosols (80%) and the free troposphere (50%), the stratosphere row carries none; the pinned SUSO data has no knots between 0 and 70% (50%/90% missing) so any low-RH stratospheric growth would need unpinned fabrication; stratospheric water vapor is decoupled from tropospheric event meteorology (J4)

sensitivity_appendix.scalar_axis_limitation: the humidity axis is a 550 nm scalar column-AOD factor: real humidification also enlarges particles and flattens the spectral slope (Angstrom decrease), which would change the shape axis beyond this model's fixed per-layer power laws; that wavelength-resolved response is not simulated (it would entangle the pinned spectral rows) and the shape ledgers above carry the resulting cost as measured, not modeled
sensitivity_appendix.rh_star_interpretation_grade: a closed RH* is the arithmetic amount of humidity the closure equation requires under the preregistered semantics; until an independent meteorological check (e.g. ERA5 along the limb path) is available it must not be cited as an observed humidity
